900.2.10(735).explanation: Exception R 735 covers a group of R-zone lands. At 455 Dovercourt Road it permits a mixed use building (12 dwelling units plus office and software uses) inside a building envelope and heights drawn on diagrams of By-law 687-2014, with a 2,824 m2 gross floor area cap, a 150 m2 stacked-parking garage, 190 m2 of soft landscaping, 25 parking spaces and 20 bicycle spaces. Other listed addresses keep former City of Toronto by-laws that still prevail. We do not evaluate these site-specific rules or the former by-laws.
